_what: Per-question decisions for the Oct-2025 General Studies import: keep-or-drop, which GS syllabus unit and leaf sub-topic it belongs to, and a one-line explanation of the keyed answer.
_split_policy: The user asked for STATIC GK only. `drop` marks a question whose value depends on when it is asked - an office holder, an annual rate, an award count, a 'recently' framing. Nothing is silently discarded: every dropped question keeps its reason here and the importer prints them, so any can be pulled back by changing `keep` to true.
_off_syllabus_note: Q78 (Gantt charts) is dropped for a different reason - it maps to no leaf of the GS syllabus at all. Project management is Technical Paper III material. Forcing it into a GS unit would be the mis-tagging bug of 2026-09-04 all over again, where a tag that merely restates the unit sends every by-topic consumer to the wrong place.
_key_quality: Unlike the CSE papers of ILM2023 (12 wrong in 135) and MES2023 (8 in 62), this General Studies key holds up: every answer I could check independently is correct. Two carry a caveat rather than a correction - Q11 (limestone/CO2, chemically loose) and Q76 (largest renewable source, overtaken by solar since the paper was set). Both are noted on the card, neither is overturned.
